text:
Maya Chen: Heads up — terraform apply to scale the GPU node pool in eu-west-1 failed and left several pods stuck Terminating. Not seeing healthy CNI on new nodes. anyone on call?
Ryan K: which CNI are we running there? calico or amazon-vpc-cni? :eyes:
Maya Chen: calico. We just bumped the cluster-addon helm chart in the gitops repo (calico chart 1.14.0 -> 1.15.0). terraform tried to add 4 g4dn nodes, they join but show NotReady, pods w/ hostNetwork hang in Terminating.
Olga Petrova: Argo shows the calico-addon sync partially failed — pre-upgrade job never finished. argocd logs show CrashLoopBackOff for calico-node init container.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: ArgoCD sync failed: repo=infra/gitops path=clusters/eu1/addons/calico status=Failed hooks 2/3
Maya Chen: pasted relevant kubelet/k8s error: ```kubelet[1234]: failed to setup network for pod "…": error configuring cni: no such device
ip link show on new node shows mtu 1500 but our VPC expects 9001 (we use jumbo frames in eu-west-1 for perf).```
Ryan K: ah — MTU mismatch. Calico 1.15 defaults changed network config if you enable eBPF mode, it overwrote mtu settings in the CNI configmap during upgrade.
Olga Petrova: confirmed — the helm chart values omit mtu by default now. Our gitops values.yaml relied on cluster default. PR 284 in gitops bumped chart and removed explicit mtu.
DevOps Oncall: quick mitigation options? rollback chart, pin MTU in values, or cordon/drain new nodes and re-create with correct cni config?
Maya Chen: attempted a rollback via argocd to previous chart but the pre-upgrade job is stuck; argocd can't complete sync until hook finishes. deployed a lightweight pod to run the fix but it's blocked because calico-daemonset init fails.
Ryan K: we can patch the calico cni config directly: ```kubectl -n kube-system patch cm calico-config -p '{"data":{"veth_mtu":"9001"}}'``` but that is manual and will be overwritten by next gitops sync. still ok for emergency.
Olga Petrova: I'll open a quick PR to pin values to `veth_mtu: 9001` and mark as "hotfix". can someone run the manual patch so nodes recover now?
Maya Chen: done, patched configmap. new nodes transitioned to Ready within ~40s, pods started terminating correctly and then restarted. :thumbsup:
DevOps Oncall: note — this revealed a hole in our rollout automation: helm chart upgrades from upstream that change defaults can silently break networking. We need a preflight check in our CI.
Ryan K: Agreed. Suggestion: add a GitHub Actions preflight that runs a small kubevirt/kind cluster installing the chart with our values and checks node Ready + pod networking smoke tests. Also add a lint step to detect removal of mtu/value keys.
Olga Petrova: I'll add a gitops policy (rego) that requires explicit mtu value for calico chart in clusters/*.yaml.
Maya Chen: cost/Capacity note — while we were troubleshooting we hit spot eviction on 2/4 new nodes. fallback to on-demand would prevent this but increases monthly cost ~€11k for reserved capacity in eu-west-1 based on our current utilization. worth discussing but not for emergency fix.
DevOps Oncall: create a follow-up ticket to evaluate on-demand reserve vs spot fallback across regions. tagging @finance for cost numbers.
argo-bot: argocd: PR 285 created by Olga Petrova -> clusters/eu1: calico values: pin veth_mtu and chart version; status=Pending merge
Maya Chen: next steps: 1) merge PR 285, 2) add preflight CI job, 3) add rego policy to block silent mtu removal, 4) run a canary upgrade in staging with 10% nodes before cluster-wide.
Ryan K: I'll take the preflight CI task. Maya/Olga — can you coordinate the rego and the PR?
Olga Petrova: yep, I'll drive the PR and rego. leaving a note in the issue with exact terraform plan snippet that caused the scale: ```terraform plan -var=cluster=eu1 -target=module.gpu_nodepool.aws_autoscaling_group.gpu[3]```
Maya Chen: thanks all. leaving the manual patch in place until gitops merges. will monitor for any other clusters where calico default mtu drifted.
DevOps Oncall: closing loop for pager — we recovered nodes and pods. follow-up ticket created: INFRA-4321 (calico mtu rollout hardening + cost review).
Olga Petrova: FYI for runbook: add step to validate CNI values in values.yaml and a k8s-smoke check after argocd sync.
Maya Chen: tagging this thread in the incident doc and the PR. :wave:
